subject_session: sub-Jenkins ses-full desc-train (MC_Maze); replication sub-Indy (MC_RTT, DANDI:000129)
stated_limitation: It is worth being explicit that this is a comparison across two datasets that differ in more than target placement (different monkey, different array, different laboratory, and a session about a tenth as long), so the inference rests on the measured mediator, the position-to-velocity R^2 of 0.49 against 0.00, rather than on the dataset contrast alone. A within-animal test, in which target placement was randomised for part of a session, would settle it more firmly than anything available here.

justification.dataset: MC_Maze (000128) is the canonical reach-tuning dataset and the run adds MC_RTT (000129) specifically to break the position/velocity confound, an expert-level choice.
justification.handling: Real data streamed via LINDI with hand velocity taken from the file, the cursor/hand coordinate offset noted, units filtered above 1 Hz, and 20 ms binning aligned to move onset.
justification.analysis: Cosine F-test, bootstrap circular preferred directions, cross-validated GLM and decoding, a position-to-velocity confound regression, and a block-shift null that correctly addresses the autocorrelation problem.
justification.correctness: Headline numbers reproduce from the committed logs and cache, are internally consistent with the figures, physically possible, and rest on adequate samples and appropriate controls.
justification.figures: The four present figures show the effect clearly with labeled units and sample sizes, but three figures referenced in the README (GLM, replication, shuffle) are absent from the directory.
justification.honesty: Claims are proportionate and the write-up names the specific limitations of this result: the cross-dataset confound, the wide per-unit lead spread, and the weaker speed replication.
justification.verdict: The core work is sound and believable, but I would ask them to supply the three referenced figures that are missing from the deliverable before signing off.
